definitions.explanation: The movement of goods, people, or materials from one place to another, typically over longer distances.

examples.japanese: {貨物|かもつ}の{輸送|ゆそう}にはトラックを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: We use trucks for transporting cargo.

examples.japanese: {輸送|ゆそう}コストを{削減|さくげん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to reduce transportation costs.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{物資|ぶっし}が{被災地|ひさいち}に{輸送|ゆそう}された。
examples.english: Large quantities of supplies were transported to the disaster area.

notes:
USAGE: {輸送|ゆそう} typically refers to large-scale or commercial transportation, rather than personal travel.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{輸送|ゆそう}する (to transport)
・{輸送|ゆそう}コスト (transportation cost)
・{輸送|ゆそう}{手段|しゅだん} (means of transport)
・{輸送|ゆそう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (transport company)

COMPOUNDS:
・{海上|かいじょう}{輸送|ゆそう} (sea transport)
・{航空|こうくう}{輸送|ゆそう} (air transport)
・{陸上|りくじょう}{輸送|ゆそう} (land transport)

RELATED:
・{運送|うんそう} - shipping, delivery
・{運搬|うんぱん} - conveyance, transport
